response.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile, s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation), grp AS (SELECT telescregistry, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase FROM linked GROUP BY telescregistry, weathprofile), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_mod FROM linked) SELECT g.weathprofile, AVG(g.avg_mod) AS avg_modindex, AVG(g.avg_phase) AS avg_phaseshift, AVG(g.avg_mod - ov.overall_mod) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall ov WHERE g.avg_mod > ov.overall_mod GROUP BY g.weathprofile

assumptions.assumption: The overall average modulation index is the average of modindex over all linked signals (those that match a telescope and an observatory), not the average of the group averages.

The per-weather-profile figures are simple averages of the retained telescope/weather group averages. Each group counts once, whatever its number of signals. Null modindex and phaseshiftdeg values are ignored by AVG.
The 'how far above' figure is the average of (group avg modindex minus overall avg modindex) over the retained groups.
